three_things: 866 rows with recorded exit velocity from 2,378 pitches seen.
83.5 mph average exit velocity with a 102.3 mph 90th percentile.
context_note: Descriptive only, from a single 2025 Statcast pull (pitches_faced_2025>=300 floor, 485 of 671 batters). Exit-velocity figures use rows with recorded exit velocity. Estimated wOBA on contact uses rows with recorded model estimates, whose count is not reported here, and is a batted-ball model: it says nothing about walks, strikeouts, or actual results. This pull carries no swing/miss or launch-angle column, so there is no whiff rate and no barrel profile here. Not park-, role-, or opponent-adjusted, and not a prediction. This pull has no sprint-speed or baserunning column, so the part of his profile that turns weak contact into outcomes is invisible here.
